title: Total stable influence on relevant coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $J\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. Suppose $f$ depends only on the coordinates in $J$, and let $\\rho\\in\\mathbb R$. Then the total stable influence of $f$ at parameter $\\rho$ equals the sum of its stable influences over $i\\in J$.
